headline: Profit and margins climb sharply year over year
summary_short: American Financial Group reported Q2 2026 revenue of $2,030M (+5.2% y/y) and net income of $248M, up 42.5% y/y, with diluted EPS of $2.99 versus $2.07 a year ago.
summary_long: Revenue was $2,030M, up 5.2% y/y and 9.5% q/q. Net income of $248M implies a net margin of 12.2%, versus 9.0% y/y and 10.3% q/q — margin expanded on both bases. Diluted EPS was $2.99, up 44.4% y/y and 30.6% q/q, on 83M weighted diluted shares (down 0.6% y/y). Operating income rose to $316M, up 38.0% y/y. Cash was $1,438M, up 13.4% y/y; long-term debt rose 23.4% y/y to $1,821M. Shareholders' equity rose 6.8% y/y to $4,821M.
